_provenance: generated from the sector137 server code at commit 4ef96f3 (packages/mcp, work domain, served at /mcp/work) by an in-memory MCP client calling tools/list; not captured from a deployed server

tools.name: agents
tools.description: Manage crew agents. Actions: list, update, activate, deactivate, dispatch.

tools.name: create_board
tools.description: Create a new board in a universe. Boards segment issues into parallel work tracks (e.g., Discovery, Delivery). Issues placed on a board stay there permanently.

tools.name: create_board_label
tools.description: Add a label to a board's vocabulary. Board labels are scoped to their board and can be applied to issues on that board.

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Create a new Sector137 product. Requires an account-scoped API key (no product associations) with the products:write scope.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.description: Create a product tag (work-item taxonomy). Tags are product-specific and created under the API key's product. Returns the new tag with its ID, which you can then assign to issues via tagIds.

tools.name: create_universe
tools.description: Create a new universe. Universes are top-level containers that group products.

tools.name: delete_board
tools.description: Delete a board. Cannot delete the Intake board. Issues on the deleted board will have their board_id cleared.

tools.name: delete_board_label
tools.description: Remove a label from a board's vocabulary. This also removes the label from all issues on the board.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.description: Delete a product tag. Also removes it from every issue it was assigned to.

tools.name: export_state
tools.description: Export the state snapshot for a product as a JSON StateDocument (issues + tasks + notes + releases + tags). Sal writes this to .sector137/state.json as the canonical local copy. Each entity is wrapped in a sync envelope with origin/serverId/etag for later reconciliation.

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Post-ship feedback signal (reactions + comments) on releases and issues. Actions: get_summary, list_comments, promote.

tools.name: get_product_tags
tools.description: List all tags for the current product. Tags are user-managed and product-specific. Use this to discover valid tag IDs before assigning tagIds to issues.

tools.name: get_universe
tools.description: Get a universe by its ID. Returns universe details including name, slug, and description.

tools.name: get_universe_context
tools.description: Get full universe context in one call — merges universe details, pipeline stats (issue counts by status), and the active release. Use this at session start for efficient orientation.

tools.name: import_state
tools.description: Push a StateDocument to the server. Locally-created entities (meta.serverId: null) get created and the server returns the new serverIds. Dirty entities with matching etag are updated. Conflicts (dirty + stale etag) are returned in results.conflicts without being auto-merged. Use this when Sal has accumulated offline changes and wants to push them up.

tools.name: issues
tools.description: Manage issues, notes, tasks, and relations. Actions: list, get, stats, by_status, roadmap_summary, create, bulk_create, update, update_status, bulk_update_status, bulk_scope, bulk_assign, delete, search_notes, list_notes, add_note, update_note, delete_note, list_tasks, create_task, update_task, complete_task, delete_task, list_relations, add_relation, remove_relation, reorder.

tools.name: list_board_labels
tools.description: List a board's label vocabulary. Board labels are scoped to their board and applied to issues on it. Use this to discover valid labelIds before attaching them at issue creation.

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: List boards for a universe. Returns all boards including the default Intake board. Boards are named work containers that segment issues into parallel work tracks.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List the people you can assign work to, in a universe or in one product. Returns userId, name, email, role, functionalRole and isOwner — resolve an assigneeId here rather than pasting a UUID. Pass universeId for the whole universe roster, or productId for just that product's members.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List Sector137 products accessible with the current API key. Product-scoped keys return their single product; account-scoped keys (no product associations) return all products for the user.

tools.name: list_universes
tools.description: List universes for the authenticated user. Universes are top-level containers that group products.

tools.name: releases
tools.description: Manage releases. Actions: list, get, get_active, update, publish, delete.

tools.name: sync_state
tools.description: Bidirectional sync: push local creates/updates, pull server-only entities, surface conflicts. Returns { document, results } — the document is the merged snapshot to write back to .sector137/state.json, results enumerates created/updated/pulled/deleted/conflicts. Sal calls this on `/sal init --sync` and after long offline stints.

tools.name: update_board
tools.description: Update a board's name, description, view mode, status, or position. Cannot update the Intake board.

tools.name: update_board_label
tools.description: Update a board label's name and/or color.

tools.name: update_tag
tools.description: Update a product tag's label and/or color.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Who this credential is and which universes it can act in. Use it to fill in assigneeId with the operator's own user id, and to discover a universeId without guessing. The universes list is empty unless the key holds universes:read.

tools.name: workflow_statuses
tools.description: Read and manage a universe's issue status vocabulary — the keys 'issues.status' is allowed to hold. Actions: list, create, update, delete, reorder. CALL action:"list" BEFORE writing any issue status: statuses are per-universe and customizable, so the seeded set (backlog, planned, in_progress, in_review, completed, cancelled) is only a starting point and a universe may have renamed or replaced all of it. Every status maps onto a fixed category (backlog, unstarted, started, review, completed, cancelled) which is what the system actually reasons about — 'started' stamps startedAt, 'completed'/'cancelled' let a release cut, 'backlog' hides an issue from the active queue. A key is IMMUTABLE after create (renaming would orphan every issue holding the old value) — to rename the human-facing name, update `label` instead. Delete refuses with 409 while issues still hold the key; pass reassignTo with another key in the same universe to move them first.
